title: [Peek] Present scan status when enumerating a folder's files
author: daverayment

status.label: Fix in progress

next_action.label: Follow linked PR

judgment.rationale: The issue is actively implemented by its collaborator-owner in PR #50213, which explicitly closes #50174 and includes validation evidence.
evidence: The issue is authored and assigned to collaborator daverayment.
The PR adds progress/state models, spinner and incomplete-result UI, error handling, and reports passing Peek unit tests and manual folder scans.

issue_context.summary: Peek folder enumeration lacks a clear running/completed/error state and currently discards partial results on failure; the owning collaborator has an open implementation addressing the full scenario.
known_information: The issue includes a recording showing ambiguous scan progress.
The proposal preserves partial results and marks them incomplete when enumeration errors occur.
Open PR #50213 explicitly closes the issue and changes the relevant previewer, models, UI, resources, and helper code.
inferences: The PR is the authoritative implementation path, though it remains subject to upstream review and merge.
issue_context.analysis: The report has already moved beyond design into an owned, validated pull request. Any dashboard-generated design or comment would duplicate the active work.
